order_wins: **DCX Systems** -- receives purchase orders of about Rs 23.06 cr for cable and wire-harness assemblies, domestic and export, plus Rs 2.47 cr of export board-assembly orders at subsidiary Raneal Advanced Systems (~1.3% of mcap).

**KD Green Industries** -- 51%-held Shivam Pipe Industries secures about Rs 6.81 cr of galvanised steel electric-pole orders for Meghalaya and Assam power-distribution utilities, via contractors (~2.5% of mcap).
**Abha Power and Steel** -- secures a new order of about Rs 1.20 cr from a reputed railway customer (~2.8% of mcap, SME).
fund_raises_fresh_equity: **Geetanjali Credit and Capital** -- Rights Issue Committee fixes the rights issue at Rs 88.38 cr: 7,07,07,200 partly paid shares at Rs 12.50, 16 for every 1 held, record date 18-Nov.
**Shalimar Paints** -- its QIP Committee opens the qualified institutional placement on 13-Nov at a floor price of Rs 80.87 per share; the issue size is not stated in this filing.
**KP Green Engineering** -- Board approves up to 34,24,657 convertible warrants at Rs 292 each to promoter-category Dr Faruk Patel, about Rs 100 cr (our arithmetic), subject to shareholder approval.
**Shakti Press** -- EGM notice for 5-Dec seeks approval to issue 71,00,000 shares at Rs 13.79 (Rs 9.79 cr) to four promoter-group allottees; proposed, not yet allotted.
**Imagicaaworld Entertainment** -- Board approves a Rs 16.25 cr preferential issue of 22,10,885 convertible warrants at Rs 73.50 to a non-promoter, subject to the 11-Dec EGM (~0.7% of mcap).
equity_allotments: **GDL Leasing & Finance** -- allots convertible warrants to non-promoters after receiving Rs 1.05 cr, 25% at Rs 3.50 per warrant; the balance Rs 10.50 a warrant falls due on conversion.
m_and_a: **Relaxo Footwears** -- Board approves a Kenya footwear JV with the Kenafric Group, subscribing up to Rs 35.70 cr for 51% of Relaxo Kenafric Footwears, plus a cash asset transfer into it (~0.5% of mcap).

**Archean Chemical Industries** -- signs a non-binding MoU with Andhra Pradesh's economic development board on a battery-storage giga-factory of up to 5 GWh a year, indicative Rs 2,000 cr; not a firm commitment.
**Blue Jet Healthcare** -- signs a non-binding MoU with the Andhra Pradesh economic development board to evaluate buying 50 acres in phases for an API plant, investment value up to Rs 500 cr.
**Money Masters Leasing & Finance** -- a new promoter group agrees to buy 34.66% for Rs 3.48 cr at Rs 1 a share and is allotted 3,34,84,139 shares at Rs 1 (Rs 3.35 cr); an open offer follows.

**Pricol** -- promoters sign a share purchase agreement to sell 4,69,34,833 shares, 38.51% of subsidiary Pricol Autotech, to Warburg Pincus affiliate Topaz Terrace Investments; price not in the cached text.
**Fusion CX** -- UK subsidiary signs a binding agreement to buy 100% of Germany's impacx group (250 staff, 270+ clients), subject to approvals; price not disclosed.
**Adani Energy Solutions** -- completes buying 100% of Intellismart Infrastructure from NIIF and EESL after CCI clearance; NIIF's convertible debentures redeemed; price not restated.
**Manipal Health Enterprises** -- completes the business-transfer acquisition of Kinder Women's Hospital and Fertility Centre in Bengaluru from Kindorama Healthcare; price not stated.

**Linde India** -- Board approves and signs a share purchase agreement for 100% of Airtech Cryogenic Gases, which had turnover of Rs 29.00 cr over nine months of operation; price not in the cached text.
**Precot** -- Board gives in-principle approval to demerge identified non-core assets under a scheme of arrangement, subject to NCLT and shareholder approval; no terms yet.

**EID Parry India** -- Board approves a slump sale of its Sivagangai distillery unit, which earned about Rs 119.58 cr of income in FY26, roughly 3% of total income; consideration not in the cached text.
capex_core: **Steelcast** -- Board approves a further Rs 31 cr to add 3,250 tons at its foundry by March 2028, on top of the Rs 120 cr and 8,500 tons approved on 29-Jul.
business_updates: **Zetwerk Manufacturing Businesses** -- H1 FY27 revenue rises 33% to Rs 8,717 cr and adjusted EBITDA 69% to Rs 274 cr; new orders Rs 7,760 cr (+48%) lift the manufacturing order book to Rs 14,595 cr.
**Proventus Agrocom** -- H1 FY27 consolidated revenue Rs 634 cr (+63%), EBITDA Rs 16.6 cr (+80%), PAT Rs 11.8 cr (+77%) on sales volume up 55% to 6,363 MT.
**Orient Cables (India)** -- H1 FY27 revenue doubles to about Rs 1,018 cr, EBITDA up 155% to Rs 119.2 cr and PAT up 194% to Rs 73.7 cr.
**Eicher Motors** -- Q2 FY27 consolidated revenue Rs 7,422 cr (+20%), EBITDA Rs 1,760 cr (+16%), PAT Rs 1,573 cr (+15%); Royal Enfield sells 3,76,722 bikes (+15%), VECV 28,071 vehicles (+28.2%).
**ABB India** -- Q3 CY2026 orders rise 56% to Rs 4,733 cr and backlog 36% to Rs 12,927 cr; revenue up 19% to Rs 3,738 cr, PAT up 10% to Rs 440 cr.
**CMS Info Systems** -- Q2 FY27 services revenue Rs 644 cr (+16.2%), the fourth straight record quarter; EBITDA up 24.8% YoY.
**Innova Captab** -- Q2 FY27 consolidated revenue Rs 496.3 cr (+30.5%), EBITDA Rs 72.4 cr (+29.2%), PAT Rs 42.4 cr (+43.0%).
**Frog Innovations** -- H1 FY27 revenue Rs 645.0 mn (about Rs 64.5 cr, +17.4%), EBITDA Rs 44.4 mn and a PAT turnaround to Rs 8.7 mn; the Rs 919.7 mn Indus Towers item is a letter of intent.
**P N Gadgil Jewellers** -- Diwali festive-season sales of Rs 689 cr, up 14% YoY, with studded jewellery 17.2% of sales.
**Oswal Pumps** -- Q2 FY27 total income Rs 511.8 cr, down 6.4% YoY but up 6.2% QoQ; EBITDA down 53.4% to Rs 62.8 cr and PAT down 59.4% to Rs 39.6 cr.
**TAKE Limited** -- H1 FY27 consolidated total income Rs 615.54 mn, about Rs 61.55 cr (our arithmetic, mn to crore).
**CSM Technologies** -- H1 FY27 total income Rs 86.28 cr and Q2 Rs 43.04 cr, with revenue recognition weighted to the second half.
distress_risk: **Yes Bank** -- files a review petition in the Supreme Court against its 15-Oct judgment on the write-down of Additional Tier-1 bonds aggregating Rs 8,415 cr.
**Jindal Poly Films** -- signs a 12-day standstill of all pending proceedings with JPFL Films and the investor, to explore an amicable settlement of the dispute.
**Rane Holdings** -- subsidiary Rane Steering Systems gets a GST order dropping a Rs 11.88 cr demand, penalty included, in its entirety.
open_offers: **Shree OSFM E-Mobility Limited** — S FLYWINGS SIMULATOR TRAINING CENTRE LIMITED open offer for 26.0% (40.05 lakh shares) at Rs 61 vs CMP 55.85 (+9.2%); change of control (Reg 4) + >25% acquisition (Reg 3(1)); intends to DELIST; **TENDER - offer above market**; tender window not in PA (comes with DPS/LoF); mcap Rs 86 cr
